note: On-demand list prices from the AWS Price List bulk API (offer files named under source.offers, publication dates there); the tool never fetches prices live. Estimates only: no Savings Plans, reserved capacity, credits, free tier, LCU or data charges. Still estimated by rule, not by a price: Multi-AZ RDS is counted as twice Single-AZ, snapshot sizes are upper bounds, and a region missing here is priced at us-east-1.

source.api: AWS Price List bulk API (public, unauthenticated offer files, CSV)

public_ipv4_hour.unit: hour per public IPv4 address, idle or in use
